specs: Sail on a 40ft Beneteau Oceanis yacht designed for comfortable coastal sailing
Explore Vancouver's coastline, Stanley Park, English Bay, and Howe Sound UNESCO Biosphere Reserve

Maximum 9 guests per charter or group sail

includes: Stories and context about coastline, landmarks, and wildlife
blurb: Guests sail on a 40ft Beneteau Oceanis yacht from Jericho Beach, exploring Vancouver's coastline, Stanley Park, and beyond. Options include private charters for groups up to 9, group sails with up to 9 guests, and full day trips to Howe Sound. The experience includes a knowledgeable skipper, safety briefing, and light refreshments.
extraNote: Full refund for cancellations due to unsafe sailing conditions; reschedule or refund options · If conditions are unsafe for group sails, guests contacted in advance with options · Weekend dates fill quickly in peak season; book early especially for July and August · Jericho Sailing Centre, 1300 Discovery St, Vancouver · May through September
